term: one thing made of all the members of a chain (τι ἐξ ἁπάντων ἕν)
definition: `ComposedOf w c`: `w` is one thing made of all the members of the chain `c`, as Physics VII.1, 242b26 says the mutually touching or continuous movers and moved would make one thing. Primitive; the only constraints on it are STMT-TOUCHING-CHAIN-FORMS-ONE and STMT-ONE-OF-INFINITE-LOCAL-CHAIN-TRAVERSES-INFINITE.
note: Stipulative because no record gives Aristotle's account of unity by contact or continuity (Physics V.3, VI.1 would source it). The typed readings use only that such a thing exists for an injective touching chain and what it would traverse.
